meta.name: bulkpublish-social-scheduling
meta.description: Schedule, publish and analyze social posts across 15 networks via BulkPublish (MCP or REST) — Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Google Business, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Discord, Telegram, Tumblr, Snapchat. Use when the user wants to post, schedule, or bulk-publish to social media, check connected channels, or read post analytics. Always check platform rules before composing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在15个社交平台统一发布、排程并查看帖子数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营多平台社媒账号，想一次性规划和发布一周内容
copy.tagline_en: Schedule and publish posts across 15 social networks from one place
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage social accounts on multiple platforms and want to plan content in advance

howto.what: Claude 能通过 BulkPublish 服务在 15 个社交网络（如 Facebook、X、Instagram 等）上安排、发布和查看帖子数据。发布前会先检查各平台规则，并和你确认内容、账号和时间。
howto.when: 当你想发布、定时或批量发布社交媒体帖子，查看已连接的账号，或读取帖子分析数据时触发。

say.text: 安排一条明天上午10点发到 X 的帖子，内容为‘新品上线’。
say.note: 会创建定时帖子并和你确认后再发布。

say.text: 查看我目前连接了哪些社交账号？
say.note: 会列出已连接的所有频道。

say.text: 分析一下上周各平台的帖子表现。
say.note: 会拉取分析数据并给出汇总。

howto.what_en: Claude can schedule, publish, and analyze posts across 15 social networks (e.g., Facebook, X, Instagram) via the BulkPublish service. It checks platform rules and confirms content, accounts, and timing with you before publishing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to publish, schedule, or bulk-publish social posts, check connected channels, or read post analytics.

say_en.text: Schedule a post to X tomorrow at 10 AM saying 'New product launch'.
say_en.note: It creates a scheduled post and confirms with you.

say_en.text: Analyze my post performance last week.
